title: DocumentIngest
description: data of POST /v1/documents (ADR-038): a file dropped on the copilot, routed to the statement import or read as a receipt, with every workflow step for the UI and the spending check-in that follows. Models only route the file and guess a category; amounts come from the document and every figure from the engine. A receipt's store name is untrusted third-party text.

statement.description: The statement import (as POST /v1/statements answers it) when kind is statement, else null.

spending.description: Null when the user has no financial model yet.

value.description: A label or a number as text (pdf, receipt, stamp, groceries, outside, 27719), never prose.

by.description: The rule or model that answered (rules, format, jev:..., naive_bayes@...).

stamped.description: The SII stamp (timbre electrónico) was decoded and confirms the print.

source.description: manual: an expense the user told the copilot about and confirmed.

payment.description: Cash is never matched with a statement charge.

verified.description: Only a verified receipt is counted.

matched_transaction.description: The statement charge that already records this purchase: the receipt is then counted once, as that charge.

corrected.description: The user typed or confirmed its total or date in the app.

counted.description: Part of this cycle's logged spending: verified, not on a statement, dated inside the cycle. A receipt from an earlier cycle is kept but does not change today's figure.

window_end.description: The eve of the next payday: the cycle runs from window_start (payday) to here.

projected.description: The forecast projects this cycle, so an overspend lowers the protected surplus; false for a cycle before the forecast's first one.

assumed.description: Conservative (P80) variable spending the forecast counts on for the cycle, CLP.

left.description: assumed - logged; negative once spending passed the assumption.

per_day.description: left // days_left, rounded down; 0 once nothing is left.

surplus_after.description: protected_surplus - overspend in a projected cycle (else protected_surplus); negative means a conservative month breaches the floor.
